name: Nova Post For WooCommerce
author: Nova Post

sections.description:
Automate cross-border shipping with Nova Post. Instantly create shipments and labels, let customers select convenient pickup branches in the checkout, and provide real-time shipment tracking.
Display accurate live shipping rates carrier calculated shipping, or use fixed rates. Save time and reduce errors, boost customer trust with flexible delivery and tracking, and expand your business across Europe and Ukraine.
Powered by Nova Post.

Features

  1. Create Nova Post Shipments with automated label and document generation.
  2. Let customers select pickup branch at checkout page.
  3. Get live shipping rates at checkout.
  4. Track shipments – tracking numbers auto-synced to orders.

Installation & Configuration

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Nova Post to configure your plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is a WooCommerce add-on and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

How do I get an API key?

You can get an API key from your Nova Post account. Contact our support for more information.
